title: Decoupled adaptive conductivity support
supersession_reason: F-AHL10A has now directly attributed all six F-AHL10 failures to the conductivity representation: exact K makes 6/6 pass, whereas exact retention/capacity with lookup K leaves 6/6 failed. Further retention-vs-K attribution is therefore no longer the next uncertainty.
question: Can a separate conductivity-specific adaptive support remove the extreme-regime fidelity failures while preserving the compact derivative-consistent retention/capacity representation and its end-to-end speed advantage?

architecture.retention_capacity: F-AHL09 derivative-consistent cubic-Hermite z=logit(Se), C from the same interpolant derivative
architecture.conductivity: independent adaptive log(K) representation with its own support and error target
architecture.near_saturation: authoritative exact handling for h > -1 cm

stage_A.purpose: find the loosest conductivity error limit that closes all six frozen F-AHL10 failures
stage_A.decision_rule: Select the loosest prospectively tested K error limit for which all six cases pass the original F-AHL10 gates.

stage_B.purpose: repeat all 12 F-AHL10 cases with the selected decoupled representation

stage_C_after_fidelity_pass.timing_protocol: same long paired alternating-order protocol as F-AHL09R
